highlights: Architected a full-stack lost-and-found platform using Ruby on Rails, React, and PostgreSQL, enabling users to create, manage, and search detailed pet reports through a RESTful API.
Implemented secure user authentication and account management with BCrypt password hashing, password reset flows, and CORS-enabled API access.
Integrated file upload and media management with Active Storage and AWS S3 to handle pet images at scale with reliable cloud storage.
Designed advanced search and discovery features with multi-criteria filtering, location-based queries, and real-time updates to improve report matching and usability.
